page.layout: One page of text, single column; a woodcut ornament at the head; a library stamp at upper right (not transcribed); a footnote-style catchword and page marker at the foot.

main_text.l: Domino in Eisla, perpetuo Zelandorum inter
NVlla animi arrogantia, vel ut ait
ille, ἰπποδυφία, eò assurgere non ex-
res in sublimi loco collocarunt, ad
de illa familiaritate posthac gloriaturus, veluti Ἐ
proverbium vetus. Longè aliud, huic epistolæ causam

page.notes: Initial N is a large woodcut decorated letter, transcribed as N. The Greek phrase "ἰπποδυφία" in the printed line is read as printed with doubtful letters; "Ἐ Διὸς σάνδαλον" likewise. The phrase "ille, ἰπποδυφία" may be misprinted; the printed form is uncertain. The stamp "Biblioteca Nazionale Roma" is omitted.
